texts: The Russian word for frog is "жаба" (pronounced "zha-ba").
The Russian word for "frog" is жаба (zhaba).

The Russian word for frog is "жаба" (pronounced as "zhaba"). This word can also be written in Cyrillic as жа́ба. If you're learning Russian, here's a sentence with the word: Меня зовут Иван, и я люблю лезечку на спину жабы, which translates to "My name is Ivan, and I like sitting on the back of a frog." (Keep in mind that in real life, it is best not to disturb or harm frogs.)
